verdict.rationale: Notte's scraping docs show structured extraction driven by a Pydantic `BaseModel` schema (`HackerNewsFeed`), and say Fetch returns either markdown or LLM-extracted structured data, which goes beyond raw text. One community user reported extraction failing on hyatt.com, but that is a single-site anecdote that does not contradict the documented schema-typed capability. Missing for 10: Zod/TypeScript schema support, documentation of validation and error behaviour, examples of extraction within agent runs, independent corroboration.
